subject: DI05019011

body.en:
Definition / principle

Production tooling repeatedly establishes the work datum and safely resists process forces.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • A jig locates/holds the work AND guides the cutting tool, commonly through drill bushes; a fixture locates/holds but does not provide that jig-type tool guidance.
  • Repeatability reduces marking-out, setting time and operator-dependent variation; interchangeability still depends on tool, machine and inspection capability.
  • Classify jigs by body/handling: plate, box, leaf, channel. Classify fixtures by duty: milling, turning, welding, assembly.
  • Tooling cost must be justified by batch size, cycle/setup savings, quality and safe access; dedicated tooling is not automatically economical for one part.
Why is a clamp not automatically a locator?

A locator defines the datum position; a clamp maintains seating and resists separating loads.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Production tooling વારંવાર work datum નક્કી કરે, process forcesને સુરક્ષિત રીતે resist કરે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Jig work locate/hold કરે અને સામાન્ય drill bushesથી tool guide કરે; fixture locate/hold કરે,આ પ્રકારનું guidance નહિ.
  • Repeatabilityથી marking-out, setting time, operator variation ઘટે; interchangeability માટે tool, machine, inspection capability પણ જોઈએ.
  • Jigs body/handling મુજબ plate, box, leaf, channel; fixtures duty મુજબ milling, turning, welding, assembly.
  • Tooling cost batch size, cycle/setup savings, quality, safe accessથી justify થાય;એક part માટે dedicated tooling હંમેશાં economical નહિ.
Clamp આપમેળે Locator કેમ નથી?

Locator datum position નક્કી કરે છે; clamp workને seated રાખે છે અને separating loads રોકે છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A free rigid body has three translations and three rotations; opposite directions are senses of these freedoms, not twelve independent freedoms.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Primary datum: three non-collinear supports on one plane constrain normal translation and rotation about two in-plane axes.
  • Secondary datum: two spaced side locators constrain side translation and remaining rotation about the primary-plane normal.
  • Tertiary datum: one end locator constrains the remaining translation; the work must be positively seated against the chosen references.
  • Clamps maintain contact and resist separating forces; do not confuse a clamp with the element defining the datum.
  • Avoid over-location, use relief for burrs/chips, and place supports beneath clamping/process loads to avoid bending thin work.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Free rigid bodyમાં ત્રણ translations,ત્રણ rotations; opposite directions તેના senses છે,બાર independent freedoms નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Primary datumના ત્રણ non-collinear supports normal translation,બે in-plane axes આસપાસ rotation રોકે.
  • Secondary datumના બે spaced side locators side translation, primary normal આસપાસ remaining rotation રોકે.
  • Tertiary datumનો એક end locator remaining translation રોકે; work references સામે properly seat થવું જોઈએ.
  • Clamps contact રાખે, separating forces resist કરે; datum define કરનાર locator સાથે ન ભેળવો.
  • Over-location ટાળો, burr/chips માટે relief આપો; clamp/process load નીચે support રાખી thin work bending ટાળો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A second full round pin in a two-hole location can over-constrain centre-distance variation.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • The round pin establishes two in-plane coordinates at the first hole; the relieved/diamond pin establishes angular orientation at the second.
  • Relief is oriented to accommodate hole-spacing variation while retaining the required transverse constraint.
  • Primary face supports still control the out-of-plane freedoms; two pins alone do not explain complete 3D location.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Two-hole locationમાં બીજો full round pin centre-distance variationને over-constrain કરી શકે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • First holeનો round pin બે in-plane coordinates નક્કી કરે; second diamond pin angular orientation.
  • Relief hole-spacing variation accommodate કરે, required transverse constraint રાખે.
  • Primary face supports out-of-plane freedoms રોકે;ફક્ત બે pinsથી complete 3D location સમજાતી નથી.

h.en: 1.3.1 Locator classification: pin, button, V and nest
h.gu: 1.3.1 Locator Classification: Pin, Button, V, Nest

body.en:
Definition / principle

Choose the locating surface from the component datum and required force path.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Pin locator: locates a suitable hole or edge; round/relieved forms accommodate the intended constraints without needless over-location.
  • Button locator: hardened replaceable contact for datum faces; three appropriately placed buttons can establish the primary plane.
  • V locator: two angled faces support a cylindrical surface and centre it in a defined plane; an axial stop may still be required.
  • Nest locator: contoured seating suits irregular or delicate work; provide relief, loading access and reliable datum contact rather than indiscriminate full contact.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Component datum, force path પરથી locating surface પસંદ કરો.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Pin locator suitable hole/edge locate કરે; round/relieved forms યોગ્ય constraints આપે.
  • Button hardened replaceable datum contact;યોગ્ય ત્રણ buttons primary plane બનાવી શકે.
  • Vના બે angled faces cylindrical surface support/centre કરે; axial stop હજી જોઈએ.
  • Nest contoured seating irregular/delicate work માટે; relief, access, reliable datum contact જોઈએ,બધી જગ્યાએ full contact નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Clamping supplies holding force AFTER location; it should drive work into supports without distorting it.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Strap clamp: bridge/strap bears on work and a heel/support; stud and nut load it. Pivot/heel positions control force distribution.
  • C-clamp: C-shaped frame carries a screw and swivel pad; turning the screw develops opposing reactions between frame and pad.
  • Place load near a supported region, leave tool/chip clearance, and avoid clamping directly over an unsupported thin span.
  • Provide quick, reliable loading and foolproof orientation; holding force, work damage and operator safety all require verification.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Location પછી clamping holding force આપે; workને supportsમાં seat કરે, distort નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Strap work, heel/support પર રહે; stud/nut load આપે; heel positions force distribution બદલે.
  • C-clamp frameમાં screw, swivel pad; screwથી frame-pad વચ્ચે opposing reactions.
  • Supported region પાસે load આપો, tool/chip clearance રાખો, unsupported thin span પર clamp નહિ.
  • Quick, reliable loading, foolproof orientation; holding force, damage, safety verify કરવાં પડે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative rigid strap: stud force4kN; work and heel contacts are80mm apart; stud is30mm from work,50mm from heel.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Moment about heel: Rwork×80=4×50
  2. Rwork=2.5kN; Rheel=4−2.5=1.5kN

Check and interpretation

This ideal statics result is not permission to select a clamp without stiffness, thread, friction and safety checks.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Assumptions

Illustrative rigid strap: stud force4kN; contacts80mm apart; stud workથી30mm, heelથી50mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Moment about heel: Rwork×80=4×50
  2. Rwork=2.5kN; Rheel=4−2.5=1.5kN

Check અને અર્થઘટન

body.en:
Definition / principle

A drilling jig fixes the work datum and guides the drill through a hardened bush.

Classification / representative type

  • Body/handling types: plate, box, leaf, channel; the following is the named representative.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A rigid plate carries bushes above the work; it may rest on work datum features or a designed base.
  2. Locators/buttons or suitable pins reproduce the part datum; they are not replaced by arbitrary clamp contact.
  3. Hardened drill bushes define drill axis and resist guide wear; support around the bush must remain rigid.
  4. Clamp and backing/support keep work seated and transfer thrust without bending it.
  5. Accessible edges permit loading; handling features must not weaken the bush plate.
  6. Feet, mounting faces and chip/drill-exit clearances support stable seating and unobstructed tool passage.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The clean part is seated on the intended base or work datum before placing the guide plate.
  2. Plate locators and supports establish position;the approved clamp seats work without bending the plate.
  3. Bush axes in the rigid plate reproduce the hole pattern relative to the part datum.
  4. During supervised drilling,the bush guides the drill while work and backing react thrust.
  5. Drill-exit and chip clearances prevent interference at the intended drilling face.
  6. After safe tool clearance,the plate/clamp arrangement releases and the hole pattern is inspected.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: datum selection, bush axis/clearance, tool access, clamping stiffness, chip space and wear.

Applications / advantages

Simple flat parts with holes from one principal face; low complexity and easy inspection.

Limitations / safety

Limited support/enclosure for complex multi-face drilling; plate flexibility and chip accumulation matter.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Drilling jig work datum રાખે, hardened bushથી drill guide કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Body/handling types plate, box, leaf, channel;નીચે named representative.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Rigid plate workની ઉપર guide bushes રાખે છે. તે workના datum features અથવા designed base પર બેસી શકે છે.
  2. Locators/buttons અથવા suitable pins partના datumને દરેક cycleમાં ફરી સ્થાપિત કરે છે;મનસ્વી clamp contactને datumનો substitute ન માનવો.
  3. Hardened drill bushes drillની axis નક્કી કરે છે અને guide wear resist કરે છે;તેની આસપાસની plate/body rigid હોવી જોઈએ.
  4. Clamp તથા backing/support workને seated રાખે છે અને cutting thrustને work વાળ્યા વગર body સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  5. Accessible edgesથી work load કરી શકાય છે;handling features આપતી વખતે bush plateની rigidity નબળી ન પડે તે જોવું જરૂરી છે.
  6. Feet,mounting faces અને chip/drill-exit clearancesથી jig સ્થિર બેસે છે અને drillને અડચણ વગર પસાર થવાનો માર્ગ મળે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. પહેલાં partને સ્વચ્છ intended base/work datum પર બેસાડાય છે,જેથી plate મુકતાં reference બદલાય નહિ.
  2. Plateના locators/supports position નક્કી કરે છે;મંજૂર clamp plateને વાળ્યા વગર workને seated રાખે છે.
  3. Rigid plateના bush axes partના datum સામે hole pattern repeat કરે છે;દરેક part પર ફરી marking-out જરૂરી નથી.
  4. Supervised drillingમાં bush drillને guide કરે છે અને work તથા backing cutting thrust સહન કરે છે.
  5. Intended face પર drill-exit તથા chip clearance રાખવાથી tool passage અને withdrawalમાં અડચણ અટકે છે.
  6. Tool સુરક્ષિત રીતે દૂર થયા પછી plate/clamp release થાય છે અને hole patternની તપાસ થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Controls datum, bush axis/clearance, tool access, clamp stiffness, chip space, wear.

Applications / લાભ

એક principal faceથી holesવાળા flat parts; simple, inspection સરળ.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Complex multi-face માટે support/enclosure limited; plate flexibility, chips ધ્યાનમાં લો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A drilling jig fixes the work datum and guides the drill through a hardened bush.

Classification / representative type

  • Body/handling types: plate, box, leaf, channel; the following is the named representative.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A box-like rigid body encloses the work and carries bushes on the required faces.
  2. Locators/buttons or suitable pins reproduce the part datum; they are not replaced by arbitrary clamp contact.
  3. Hardened drill bushes define drill axis and resist guide wear; support around the bush must remain rigid.
  4. Clamp and backing/support keep work seated and transfer thrust without bending it.
  5. Loading cover and multiple seating feet permit intended face access without losing the same datum relationship.
  6. Feet, mounting faces and chip/drill-exit clearances support stable seating and unobstructed tool passage.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The cover opens and the part is seated against internal datums,then secured with the intended closure.
  2. The box is supported on its designed stable feet for the first required drilling face.
  3. Bushes on that face guide the tools while body and internal supports carry thrust.
  4. After safe withdrawal,the closed jig is reoriented onto another designed seating face without independently relocating the part.
  5. Other face holes retain their common datum relationship;chips must not affect feet or internal seating.
  6. After all intended faces and safe tool clearance,the cover releases for unloading and inspection.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: datum selection, bush axis/clearance, tool access, clamping stiffness, chip space and wear.

Applications / advantages

Multi-face holes on a prismatic component; reduces independent re-setting between faces.

Limitations / safety

Heavier, costlier and more difficult chip access; only intended stable faces may be used for orientation.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Drilling jig work datum રાખે, hardened bushથી drill guide કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Body/handling types plate, box, leaf, channel;નીચે named representative.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Box જેવી rigid body workને ઘેરી રાખે છે અને required faces પર guide bushes ધરાવે છે,જેથી multi-face holesનો સંબંધ જળવાય.
  2. Locators/buttons અથવા suitable pins partના datumને દરેક cycleમાં ફરી સ્થાપિત કરે છે;મનસ્વી clamp contactને datumનો substitute ન માનવો.
  3. Hardened drill bushes drillની axis નક્કી કરે છે અને guide wear resist કરે છે;તેની આસપાસની plate/body rigid હોવી જોઈએ.
  4. Clamp તથા backing/support workને seated રાખે છે અને cutting thrustને work વાળ્યા વગર body સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  5. Loading cover અને multiple seating feetથી ઇચ્છિત faces સુધી પહોંચાય છે,પણ workનો મૂળ datum relationship બદલાતો નથી.
  6. Feet,mounting faces અને chip/drill-exit clearancesથી jig સ્થિર બેસે છે અને drillને અડચણ વગર પસાર થવાનો માર્ગ મળે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Cover ખોલીને partને અંદરના datums સામે બેસાડાય છે;પછી intended closureથી secure કરાય છે.
  2. પહેલાં required drilling face માટે boxને તેના designed stable feet પર આધાર અપાય છે.
  3. તે faceના bushes toolsને guide કરે છે;body અને અંદરના supports thrust સહન કરે છે.
  4. Safe withdrawal પછી closed jigને બીજા designed seating face પર orient કરાય છે;partને અંદરથી ફરી independently locate કરાતો નથી.
  5. બીજા faceના holes common datum relationship જાળવે છે;chips feet અથવા અંદરની seatingને અસર ન કરવા જોઈએ.
  6. બધા intended facesનું કામ અને safe tool clearance પછી cover release કરીને part ઉતારાય છે અને તપાસ થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Controls datum, bush axis/clearance, tool access, clamp stiffness, chip space, wear.

Applications / લાભ

Prismatic componentનાં multi-face holes; faces વચ્ચે independent re-setting ઘટે.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Heavy, costly, chip access મુશ્કેલ;ફક્ત intended stable facesથી orientation.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A drilling jig fixes the work datum and guides the drill through a hardened bush.

Classification / representative type

  • Body/handling types: plate, box, leaf, channel; the following is the named representative.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Base contains location/support and a hinged leaf carries the guide bushes.
  2. Locators/buttons or suitable pins reproduce the part datum; they are not replaced by arbitrary clamp contact.
  3. Hardened drill bushes define drill axis and resist guide wear; support around the bush must remain rigid.
  4. Clamp and backing/support keep work seated and transfer thrust without bending it.
  5. Hinge permits opening for loading; positive seating and a latch secure the leaf—the hinge alone must not establish precision closure.
  6. Feet, mounting faces and chip/drill-exit clearances support stable seating and unobstructed tool passage.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. The leaf swings open so the part can enter the base without passing beneath a fixed bush plate.
  2. The work seats on base datums and is held by the designed retention arrangement.
  3. The leaf closes onto positive seats and its latch secures repeatable bush alignment;hinge play must not define accuracy.
  4. During the approved drilling cycle,the closed rigid leaf guides the drill through its bushes.
  5. The tool is safely withdrawn before the latch is released and the leaf is opened.
  6. The part is unloaded and inspected;wear at hinge,latch or seating is corrected before it harms repeatability.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: datum selection, bush axis/clearance, tool access, clamping stiffness, chip space and wear.

Applications / advantages

Frequent loading/unloading of similar drilled parts; open leaf gives convenient access.

Limitations / safety

Hinge/latch wear and leaf deflection affect guidance; closure repeatability needs maintenance.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Drilling jig work datum રાખે, hardened bushથી drill guide કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Body/handling types plate, box, leaf, channel;નીચે named representative.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Baseમાં locating અને supporting elements હોય છે;hingeથી જોડાયેલી leaf ઉપર drill-guiding bushes રાખવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Locators/buttons અથવા suitable pins partના datumને દરેક cycleમાં ફરી સ્થાપિત કરે છે;મનસ્વી clamp contactને datumનો substitute ન માનવો.
  3. Hardened drill bushes drillની axis નક્કી કરે છે અને guide wear resist કરે છે;તેની આસપાસની plate/body rigid હોવી જોઈએ.
  4. Clamp તથા backing/support workને seated રાખે છે અને cutting thrustને work વાળ્યા વગર body સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  5. Hinge leaf ખોલીને loading કરવાની સગવડ આપે છે. Positive seats અને latch precision closure રાખે છે;ફક્ત hinge પૂરતો નથી.
  6. Feet,mounting faces અને chip/drill-exit clearancesથી jig સ્થિર બેસે છે અને drillને અડચણ વગર પસાર થવાનો માર્ગ મળે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Leaf ખુલતાં part baseમાં સરળતાથી પ્રવેશે છે;fixed bush plate નીચે સરકાવવો પડતો નથી.
  2. Work baseના datums પર બેસે છે અને designed retentionથી સ્થાન જાળવે છે.
  3. Leaf positive seats પર બંધ થાય છે અને latch bush alignment repeat કરાવે છે;hingeના play પરથી accuracy નક્કી ન થવી જોઈએ.
  4. મંજૂર drilling cycleમાં બંધ અને rigid leafના bushes drillને guide કરે છે.
  5. Latch છોડવા અને leaf ખોલવા પહેલાં tool સંપૂર્ણ સુરક્ષિત રીતે withdraw થયેલું હોવું જોઈએ.
  6. Part ઉતારી તપાસાય છે;hinge,latch અથવા seatingનો wear repeatability બગાડે તે પહેલાં સંભાળાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Controls datum, bush axis/clearance, tool access, clamp stiffness, chip space, wear.

Applications / લાભ

Similar drilled partsનું frequent loading; open leaf access આપે.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Hinge/latch wear, leaf deflection guidance બદલે; closure repeatability maintenance માંગે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A drilling jig fixes the work datum and guides the drill through a hardened bush.

Classification / representative type

  • Body/handling types: plate, box, leaf, channel; the following is the named representative.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. A channel-shaped body supports suitable work between its web/flanges and carries bushes on the selected face.
  2. Locators/buttons or suitable pins reproduce the part datum; they are not replaced by arbitrary clamp contact.
  3. Hardened drill bushes define drill axis and resist guide wear; support around the bush must remain rigid.
  4. Clamp and backing/support keep work seated and transfer thrust without bending it.
  5. Open-ended access supports sliding/loading of compatible elongated or prismatic work; an end stop controls axial position.
  6. Feet, mounting faces and chip/drill-exit clearances support stable seating and unobstructed tool passage.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Suitable work slides/loads through the open end into the channel body.
  2. Web/flange references and the end stop establish transverse and axial location.
  3. Clamping seats work against supported datums without spreading or distorting the channel.
  4. The selected face bushes guide supervised drilling while the body/supports resist thrust.
  5. Chip and drill-exit space stays clear;the axial stop must remain free of debris that would shift hole position.
  6. After safe withdrawal and release,the part leaves by the planned open access and is inspected.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: datum selection, bush axis/clearance, tool access, clamping stiffness, chip space and wear.

Applications / advantages

Repeated holes in suitable bar/channel-like components; simple accessible construction.

Limitations / safety

Only suitable shapes fit reliably; flange rigidity, axial stop and chip relief must be checked.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Drilling jig work datum રાખે, hardened bushથી drill guide કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Body/handling types plate, box, leaf, channel;નીચે named representative.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Channel-shaped body તેના web/flanges વચ્ચે suitable workને support કરે છે અને પસંદ કરેલા face પર bushes રાખે છે.
  2. Locators/buttons અથવા suitable pins partના datumને દરેક cycleમાં ફરી સ્થાપિત કરે છે;મનસ્વી clamp contactને datumનો substitute ન માનવો.
  3. Hardened drill bushes drillની axis નક્કી કરે છે અને guide wear resist કરે છે;તેની આસપાસની plate/body rigid હોવી જોઈએ.
  4. Clamp તથા backing/support workને seated રાખે છે અને cutting thrustને work વાળ્યા વગર body સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  5. Open-endથી compatible elongated/prismatic work સરકાવી load કરી શકાય છે;end stop તેનું axial position નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.
  6. Feet,mounting faces અને chip/drill-exit clearancesથી jig સ્થિર બેસે છે અને drillને અડચણ વગર પસાર થવાનો માર્ગ મળે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Suitable workને open endથી channel bodyમાં સરકાવી અથવા યોગ્ય રીતે load કરવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Web/flange references તથા end stop workનું transverse અને axial location નક્કી કરે છે.
  3. Clamp channelને ફેલાવ્યા કે વાળ્યા વગર workને supported datums સામે બેસાડે છે.
  4. Selected faceના bushes supervised drillingમાં guide કરે છે અને body/supports thrust resist કરે છે.
  5. Chip/drill-exit space clear રહે છે;axial stop પર debris હોય તો hole position ખસી શકે છે.
  6. Safe withdrawal અને release પછી part planned open accessથી બહાર લેવાય છે અને તપાસ થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Controls datum, bush axis/clearance, tool access, clamp stiffness, chip space, wear.

Applications / લાભ

Suitable bar/channel-like partsમાં repeated holes; simple accessible construction.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

ફક્ત suitable shapes reliably fit; flange rigidity, axial stop, chip relief check.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A drill bush is a wear-resistant guide whose axis is positioned from the work datum.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Fixed bush is secured directly in the jig plate for relatively permanent service; replacement can disturb its receiving seat if poorly managed.
  • Renewable bush is retained in a permanent liner/seat and replaced when worn; retention prevents unwanted rotation/lift.
  • Slip-renewable arrangements permit a suitable sequence of tools through the same guided location; they are not licence to mix unapproved tool clearances.
  • Applications: repeated drilling/reaming/counterboring as designed; guide length, wear, chip clearance and distance to work affect accuracy.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Drill bush wear-resistant guide છે,જેની axis work datumથી positioned હોય.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Fixed bush plateમાં secured; relatively permanent service; poor replacementથી seat બગડી શકે.
  • Renewable bush permanent liner/seatમાં; wear થાય ત્યારે replace; retention rotation/lift અટકાવે.
  • Slip-renewableમાં same locationથી suitable tool sequence; unapproved clearances mix નહિ.
  • Designed drilling/reaming/counterboring; guide length, wear, chips, work distance accuracy બદલે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A fixture locates and holds work while the machine/process supplies its own tool path.

Classification / representative type

  • Classify by duty: milling, turning, welding, assembly; do not call every fixture a drill-guiding jig.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Rigid base interfaces with machine table; keys/setting references establish fixture orientation.
  2. Locators reproduce the component datums rather than the rough outline alone.
  3. Supports beneath load-bearing regions resist milling forces and clamping distortion.
  4. Straps or suitable clamps hold work into supports without obstructing cutter travel.
  5. Setting block/reference permits cutter-to-fixture relationship; it is not a drill bush.
  6. Chip relief and tool/run-out clearances permit safe access and repeatable seating.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Part seats against primary, secondary and end references.
  2. Clamps react against supported surfaces and resist separating force components.
  3. Cutter position is established by machine reference/setting arrangement.
  4. Machine feed moves cutter and work relatively while fixture reacts cutting loads.
  5. Chips leave the cutting region without collecting on reference seats.
  6. After safe tool clearance, work is released and dimensions checked before repetition.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: datum repeatability, holding-force path, access, changeover and inspection; process-specific controls below also matter.

Applications / advantages

Repeated slots, faces and profiles; less independent setup for a batch.

Limitations / safety

Rigidity and cutter clearance are essential; clamps must not be used as accidental cutting stops.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fixture work locate/hold કરે; tool path machine/process આપે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Duty મુજબ milling, turning, welding, assembly;દરેક fixture drill-guiding jig નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Rigid base machine table સાથે જોડાય છે;keys અથવા setting references fixtureની orientation નક્કી કરે છે.
  2. Locators componentના specified datumsને repeat કરે છે;ફક્ત rough outline સામે part મુકવો પૂરતો નથી.
  3. Load-bearing regionsની નીચે supports રાખવાથી milling force resist થાય છે અને clampingથી work વળતું અટકે છે.
  4. Straps અથવા suitable clamps workને supports સામે પકડી રાખે છે,પણ cutterના travelમાં અવરોધ બનાવતા નથી.
  5. Setting block/reference cutter અને fixtureનો સંબંધ સ્થાપિત કરે છે;તે drill-guiding bush નથી.
  6. Chip relief તથા tool/run-out clearancesથી access સુરક્ષિત રહે છે અને chipsના કારણે seating બદલાતી નથી.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Partને primary,secondary અને end references સામે બેસાડીને તેનું position સ્થાપિત થાય છે.
  2. Clamps supported surfaces સામે force આપે છે અને workને referenceથી અલગ કરનારા force components resist કરે છે.
  3. Machine reference/setting arrangementથી cutterનું સ્થાન નક્કી થાય છે;fixture પોતે drill bush જેવી guidance આપતું નથી.
  4. Machine feed cutter અને work વચ્ચે relative motion આપે છે;કાપતી વખતે fixture cutting loads સહન કરે છે.
  5. Chips cutting regionમાંથી બહાર જાય છે અને reference seats પર ભેગા ન થાય તે જરૂરી છે.
  6. Tool સુરક્ષિત રીતે clear થયા પછી work release થાય છે;આગળના cycle પહેલાં dimensions તપાસવામાં આવે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Datum repeatability, holding-force path, access, changeover, inspection તથા process-specific controls.

Applications / લાભ

Repeated slots, faces, profiles; batchમાં independent setup ઘટે.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Rigidity, cutter clearance જરૂરી; clampને accidental cutting stop ન બનાવો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A fixture locates and holds work while the machine/process supplies its own tool path.

Classification / representative type

  • Classify by duty: milling, turning, welding, assembly; do not call every fixture a drill-guiding jig.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Faceplate/chuck-adapter body connects fixture to rotating spindle.
  2. Locators position an irregular workpiece relative to intended rotational datum.
  3. Clamps retain work against radial, axial and torque loads.
  4. Supports/backing distribute load to prevent thin-section deformation.
  5. Counterbalance arrangement where needed controls unbalance; mass distribution is a safety requirement.
  6. Clearances prevent tool interference with fasteners/body throughout rotation.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Work is located to the specified spindle-related datum.
  2. Approved retention secures it and the whole rotating assembly is checked for clearance/balance.
  3. Spindle rotates fixture and work together.
  4. Tool follows machine-controlled feed to turn/bore the required feature.
  5. Cutting torque and centrifugal effects are resisted through body and spindle interface.
  6. Only after safe complete stop can the part be released and gauged.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: datum repeatability, holding-force path, access, changeover and inspection; process-specific controls below also matter.

Applications / advantages

Irregular parts unsuited to ordinary chuck jaws.

Limitations / safety

Balance, speed limits and secure retention are essential; no live adjustment instructions are provided.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fixture work locate/hold કરે; tool path machine/process આપે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Duty મુજબ milling, turning, welding, assembly;દરેક fixture drill-guiding jig નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Faceplate/chuck-adapter body fixtureને rotating spindle સાથે જોડે છે,જેથી બન્ને સાથે ફરી શકે.
  2. Locators irregular workpieceને required rotational datum સામે યોગ્ય positionમાં રાખે છે.
  3. Clamps radial,axial તથા torque loads સામે workને સુરક્ષિત રીતે પકડી રાખે છે.
  4. Supports/backing load વહેંચે છે અને પાતળા sectionsમાં deformation થતું ઘટાડે છે.
  5. જ્યાં જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં counterbalanceથી unbalance ઘટાડાય છે;rotating assemblyનું mass distribution safety requirement છે.
  6. Clearances એવા હોય છે કે આખા rotation દરમિયાન tool fasteners અથવા fixture body સાથે અથડાય નહિ.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Workને specified spindle-related datum સામે locate કરવામાં આવે છે,જેથી required axis યોગ્ય આવે.
  2. Approved retentionથી work secure થાય છે અને સંપૂર્ણ rotating assemblyનું clearance તથા balance તપાસાય છે.
  3. Spindle fixture અને workને એકસાથે rotate કરે છે;work fixtureમાં stationary relative position રાખે છે.
  4. Machine-controlled feed મુજબ tool required featureનું turning અથવા boring કરે છે.
  5. Cutting torque અને centrifugal effects body તથા spindle interface મારફતે resist થાય છે.
  6. સંપૂર્ણ સુરક્ષિત stop થયા પછી જ part release થાય છે અને gauging કરવામાં આવે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Datum repeatability, holding-force path, access, changeover, inspection તથા process-specific controls.

Applications / લાભ

Ordinary chuck jaws માટે unsuitable irregular parts.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Balance, speed limits, retention જરૂરી; live adjustment instructions નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A fixture locates and holds work while the machine/process supplies its own tool path.

Classification / representative type

  • Classify by duty: milling, turning, welding, assembly; do not call every fixture a drill-guiding jig.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Rigid base supports datum layout without unnecessarily restraining thermal expansion.
  2. Locators/stops establish relative positions of parts before joining.
  3. Clamps hold joints while permitting the approved weld sequence.
  4. Backings/supports and heat-resistant contact choices suit the joint design.
  5. Torch access, ventilation and spatter relief protect both operation and reference seats.
  6. Release allowance/removable elements permit removal after thermal contraction.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Parts are placed against the designed assembly datums.
  2. Joint gaps/alignment are verified before clamping.
  3. Clamps retain the planned relationship without crushing thin material.
  4. Qualified welding follows an approved sequence; fixture reacts positioning loads as heat enters.
  5. Thermal distortion is controlled by layout, sequence and appropriate restraint—not by assuming zero expansion.
  6. After safe cooling/release conditions, the assembly is removed and weld/dimensional inspection follows.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: datum repeatability, holding-force path, access, changeover and inspection; process-specific controls below also matter.

Applications / advantages

Repeatable frames/brackets/assemblies.

Limitations / safety

Over-restraint can lock in stress or trap the assembly; welding fumes, radiation and fire need approved controls.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fixture work locate/hold કરે; tool path machine/process આપે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Duty મુજબ milling, turning, welding, assembly;દરેક fixture drill-guiding jig નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Rigid base datum layoutને આધાર આપે છે,પણ thermal expansionને બિનજરૂરી રીતે સંપૂર્ણ રોકતું નથી.
  2. Locators/stops joining પહેલાં partsની relative position નક્કી કરે છે,જેથી joint alignment repeat થાય.
  3. Clamps jointsને પકડી રાખે છે અને approved welding sequence માટે જરૂરી access આપે છે.
  4. Backings/supports તથા heat-resistant contact materials joint designને અનુરૂપ પસંદ થાય છે.
  5. Torch access,ventilation તથા spatter reliefથી welding operation અને reference seats બન્ને સુરક્ષિત રહે છે.
  6. Release allowance/removable elements રાખવાથી thermal contraction પછી assemblyને કાઢી શકાય છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Partsને designed assembly datums સામે મુકીને શરૂઆતનો સંબંધ સ્થાપિત કરવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Clamping પહેલાં joint gaps અને alignmentની તપાસ થાય છે,જેથી ખોટી સ્થિતિ lock ન થાય.
  3. Clamps thin materialને crush કર્યા વગર planned part relationship જાળવે છે.
  4. Qualified welding approved sequenceથી થાય છે;heat આવતાં fixture positioning loads સહન કરે છે.
  5. Layout,weld sequence અને appropriate restraintથી thermal distortion નિયંત્રિત થાય છે;expansion શૂન્ય છે એવું માનવામાં આવતું નથી.
  6. Safe cooling/release conditions પછી assembly કાઢાય છે અને weld તથા dimensionsની તપાસ થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Datum repeatability, holding-force path, access, changeover, inspection તથા process-specific controls.

Applications / લાભ

Repeatable frames, brackets, assemblies.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Over-restraint stress/trapping કરે; fumes, radiation, fire approved controls માંગે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A fixture locates and holds work while the machine/process supplies its own tool path.

Classification / representative type

  • Classify by duty: milling, turning, welding, assembly; do not call every fixture a drill-guiding jig.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Base supports component reference and subassembly stability.
  2. Locating pins/nests establish relative part positions.
  3. Clamps or temporary retainers prevent shifting during joining.
  4. Guides/access windows permit the intended fitting/fastening path.
  5. Foolproof features distinguish orientation or part variant where possible.
  6. Gauging references and release features permit verification/removal.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Correct component variant is identified.
  2. Primary component seats in its datum nest.
  3. Additional parts locate relative to that datum rather than by uncontrolled hand alignment.
  4. Retention maintains alignment during the approved assembly operation.
  5. Presence, orientation and required fit/fastening characteristics are checked.
  6. Retention releases without damaging the assembly and the next cycle can repeat.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: datum repeatability, holding-force path, access, changeover and inspection; process-specific controls below also matter.

Applications / advantages

Repeatable fitting, fastening and subassembly inspection.

Limitations / safety

A fixture does not guarantee correct torque, fit or missing-part detection unless those checks are built in.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fixture work locate/hold કરે; tool path machine/process આપે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Duty મુજબ milling, turning, welding, assembly;દરેક fixture drill-guiding jig નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Base componentના referenceને આધાર આપે છે અને subassemblyને સ્થિર રાખે છે.
  2. Locating pins/nests partsની relative position નક્કી કરે છે,જેથી fitting relation repeat થાય.
  3. Clamps અથવા temporary retainers joining દરમિયાન parts ખસી ન જાય તે માટે હોય છે.
  4. Guides/access windows intended fitting અથવા fastening path માટે જગ્યા અને દિશા આપે છે.
  5. જ્યાં શક્ય હોય ત્યાં foolproof featuresથી wrong orientation અથવા wrong part variant અલગ ઓળખાય છે.
  6. Gauging references અને release featuresથી assemblyની ચકાસણી તથા removal કરી શકાય છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. પહેલાં યોગ્ય component variant ઓળખાય છે,જેથી ખોટો part assemblyમાં ન જાય.
  2. Primary component પોતાના datum nestમાં બેસે છે અને મુખ્ય reference સ્થાપિત કરે છે.
  3. બીજા parts આ datum સામે locate થાય છે;અનિયંત્રિત hand alignment પર આધાર રાખવામાં આવતો નથી.
  4. Approved assembly operation દરમિયાન retention alignmentને સ્થિર રાખે છે.
  5. Partsની presence,orientation અને required fit/fastening characteristicsની તપાસ થાય છે.
  6. Assemblyને નુકસાન કર્યા વગર retention release થાય છે અને આગળનો cycle ફરી કરી શકાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Datum repeatability, holding-force path, access, changeover, inspection તથા process-specific controls.

Applications / લાભ

Repeatable fitting, fastening, subassembly inspection.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Built-in checks વગર correct torque, fit, missing-part detectionની guarantee નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Matched punch/die tooling converts press ram motion into a controlled sheet cutting/forming operation.

Classification / representative type

  • Function: cutting versus forming tools; sequence: simple, compound, progressive dies.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Upper shoe/punch holder connects punch assembly to press slide.
  2. Lower shoe/die block supports the die and transfers load to the bolster.
  3. Punch and die edges define operation contour; clearance is selected for material/thickness and operation.
  4. Guide pillars/bushes maintain upper/lower alignment.
  5. Stripper removes sheet from punch on return; pressure pads may hold material during forming.
  6. Stops/feed guides position stock; relief/openings allow scrap/blank exit without jamming.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Stock is indexed/located at the designed position through approved guarded feeding.
  2. Ram approaches while guides maintain punch/die relationship.
  3. Punch contacts sheet and stress rises into plastic deformation.
  4. Cutting penetrates/fractures the section or forming bends it according to the tool geometry.
  5. On return, the stripper releases stock and product/scrap follows the intended path.
  6. Next feed occurs only under the approved interlocked cycle; inspection checks burr, shape and dimensions.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: shut height, stroke, press capacity, per-side clearance, alignment, feed pitch and stripping load; not universal settings.

Applications / advantages

High-repeatability sheet-metal production with cutting or forming tooling.

Limitations / safety

Point-of-operation crushing/cutting hazards require engineered guarding and trained supervision; no hand-feeding recipe is provided.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Matched punch/die press ram motionથી controlled sheet cutting/forming કરે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Function cutting/forming; sequence simple, compound, progressive dies.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Upper shoe/punch holder punch assemblyને press slide સાથે જોડે છે,જેથી slideનો stroke punch સુધી પહોંચે.
  2. Lower shoe/die block dieને આધાર આપે છે અને cutting/forming load bolster સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  3. Punch અને dieની edges operationનો contour નક્કી કરે છે;clearance material,thickness અને operation મુજબ પસંદ થાય છે.
  4. Guide pillars/bushes upper અને lower assembliesનું alignment જાળવે છે,જેથી edges ખોટી રીતે અથડાય નહિ.
  5. Return વખતે stripper sheetને punchથી અલગ કરે છે;formingમાં pressure pads material hold કરી શકે છે.
  6. Stops/feed guides stockનું position નક્કી કરે છે;relief/openings product તથા scrapને jam થયા વગર બહાર જવા આપે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Approved guarded feedingથી stock designed position પર index અથવા locate થાય છે.
  2. Ram નજીક આવે ત્યારે guides punch અને die વચ્ચેનો યોગ્ય સંબંધ જાળવે છે.
  3. Punch sheetને સ્પર્શે છે અને stress વધતાં materialમાં plastic deformation શરૂ થાય છે.
  4. Tool geometry મુજબ cuttingમાં section penetrate/fracture થાય છે અથવા formingમાં material bend થાય છે.
  5. Return strokeમાં stripper stock છોડાવે છે અને product/scrap પોતાના intended માર્ગે બહાર જાય છે.
  6. આગળનો feed ફક્ત approved interlocked cycleમાં થાય છે;inspectionથી burr,shape અને dimensions તપાસાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Shut height, stroke, capacity, per-side clearance, alignment, feed pitch, stripping load; universal settings નહિ.

Applications / લાભ

Repeatable sheet cutting/forming production.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Crushing/cutting hazards માટે guarding, trained supervision; hand-feeding recipe નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Shearing separates sheet through controlled edge loading; identify which separated portion is the product.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Shearing sequence: elastic loading, plastic penetration, fracture and separation; burr/rollover depend on tooling/material/clearance.
  • Blanking: cut-out blank is the product; die opening controls nominal outside blank size. Punch is smaller by twice per-side clearance.
  • Piercing: hole is required; removed slug is scrap. Punch controls nominal hole size; die is larger by twice per-side clearance.
  • Cutting-force estimate F≈perimeter×thickness×shear strength; stripping, shock, off-centre load and press-energy checks are additional.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Shearing controlled edgesથી sheet અલગ કરે;કયો ભાગ product છે તે ઓળખો.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Sequence elastic loading, plastic penetration, fracture, separation; burr/rollover tooling/material/clearance પર.
  • Blankingમાં cut-out product; die nominal outside size આપે; punch twice per-side clearanceથી નાનો.
  • Piercingમાં hole required, slug scrap; punch hole size, die twice per-side clearanceથી મોટી.
  • Cutting force F≈perimeter×thickness×shear strength; stripping, shock, off-centre load, energy checks extra.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Illustrative circular feature20mm, sheet1mm, per-side clearance.05mm, shear strength300N/mm².

Step-by-step solution

  1. Blanking: die20mm; punch20−2(.05)=19.90mm
  2. Piercing: punch20mm; die20+2(.05)=20.10mm
  3. Nominal cutting force≈pi×20×1×300=18849.6N=18.85kN

Check and interpretation

Nominal perimeter approximation only; do not select press capacity from this force alone.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Assumptions

Circular feature20mm, sheet1mm, per-side clearance.05mm, shear strength300N/mm².

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Blanking: die20mm; punch20−2(.05)=19.90mm
  2. Piercing: punch20mm; die20+2(.05)=20.10mm
  3. Nominal cutting force≈pi×20×1×300=18849.6N=18.85kN

Check અને અર્થઘટન

Nominal perimeter approximation;ફક્ત આ force પરથી press capacity નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Bending plastically changes sheet curvature while inner fibres compress and outer fibres extend.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Forms: V-bending, U-bending, edge/wipe bending; tool contact/support differ.
  • Neutral layer has approximately zero longitudinal strain; its location and bend allowance depend on material and bend geometry.
  • Elastic recovery after unloading causes springback; compensation uses approved tooling/process design, not an assumed universal angle.
  • Radius, thickness, grain direction, ductility and surface condition affect cracking and dimensional result.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Bending curvature plastically બદલે; inner fibres compress, outer extend.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Forms V, U, edge/wipe; contact/support જુદાં.
  • Neutral layerમાં લગભગ zero longitudinal strain; location, bend allowance material, geometry પર.
  • Unloading પછી elastic recovery springback; approved designથી compensation, universal angle નહિ.
  • Radius, thickness, grain direction, ductility, surface cracking, dimensions બદલે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

One operation is performed at one station per press stroke.

Classification / representative type

  • Sequence class: simple operation; multiple separate dies may be needed for a multi-feature part.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Upper/lower shoes support aligned tool assemblies.
  2. Punch/die members define the required cutting contours.
  3. Guide pillars/bushes maintain registration under stroke.
  4. Stripper/pads separate stock from tools and manage holding where needed.
  5. Single operation station has a matching stop/locating reference.
  6. Scrap/product exit and feed guidance prevent accumulation and positional error.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Stock reaches the single station.
  2. Location is established for that one feature.
  3. Ram drives the punch into the intended operation.
  4. One cutting/forming action occurs.
  5. Return stroke strips/releases stock.
  6. Part or stock is removed/advanced for a later separate operation if needed.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: operation identity, stock positioning, clearance, alignment, load and stripping; progressive tools additionally require correct pitch.

Applications / advantages

Low-complexity work, simple tooling and easier maintenance.

Limitations / safety

Multiple setups can reduce productivity/relative-feature accuracy.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

એક strokeમાં એક station પર એક operation.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Sequence class simple; multi-feature માટે અલગ dies જોઈએ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Upper/lower shoes aligned tool assembliesને આધાર આપે છે અને loadsને press structure સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  2. Punch/die members required cutting contours નક્કી કરે છે,જેથી ઇચ્છિત feature ઉતરે.
  3. Guide pillars/bushes stroke દરમિયાન assembliesનું registration જાળવે છે.
  4. Stripper/pads stockને toolsથી અલગ કરે છે અને જ્યાં જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં holding આપે છે.
  5. એક operation station માટે matching stop/locating reference હોય છે,જેથી featureનું position repeat થાય.
  6. Scrap/product exit અને feed guidanceથી accumulation તથા positional error ઘટાડાય છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Stock એકમાત્ર station સુધી પહોંચાડવામાં આવે છે,જ્યાં આ operation થવાનું છે.
  2. તે feature માટે જરૂરી location સ્થાપિત થાય છે;બીજા operationનું કામ અલગ હોઈ શકે છે.
  3. Ram punchને ઇચ્છિત operation તરફ આગળ ચલાવે છે.
  4. આ station પર એક cutting/forming action થાય છે;multiple cutting operations એકસાથે હોવાની શરત નથી.
  5. Return stroke stockને strip/release કરે છે,જેથી toolમાંથી stock છૂટે.
  6. જરૂર હોય તો part અથવા stockને પછીના અલગ operation માટે remove/advance કરવામાં આવે છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Operation, stock position, clearance, alignment, load, stripping; progressiveમાં correct pitch.

Applications / લાભ

Low-complexity work, simple tooling, maintenance સરળ.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Multiple setups productivity/relative accuracy ઘટાડે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Two or more CUTTING operations occur at the SAME station in one stroke.

Classification / representative type

  • Compound is not progressive: stations do not step different operations along a strip; cutting plus forming is often called combination tooling.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Upper/lower shoes support aligned tool assemblies.
  2. Punch/die members define the required cutting contours.
  3. Guide pillars/bushes maintain registration under stroke.
  4. Stripper/pads separate stock from tools and manage holding where needed.
  5. Nested punch/die members perform blanking/piercing at one station with appropriate ejection.
  6. Scrap/product exit and feed guidance prevent accumulation and positional error.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Stock is located at the common station.
  2. Guides align nested members.
  3. Stroke brings multiple cutting contours into action.
  4. Blanking and piercing occur in that station during the same stroke.
  5. Stripping/ejection separates product and scrap.
  6. Complete cut profile is checked relative to its simultaneously produced hole.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: operation identity, stock positioning, clearance, alignment, load and stripping; progressive tools additionally require correct pitch.

Applications / advantages

Washers and flat parts needing good hole-to-outline relationship.

Limitations / safety

Higher tool complexity, load and ejection demands.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

એક strokeમાં SAME station પર બે/વધુ CUTTING operations.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Compound progressive નહિ; strip પર અલગ stations નહિ; cutting+formingને ઘણી વાર combination કહે.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Upper/lower shoes aligned tool assembliesને આધાર આપે છે અને loadsને press structure સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  2. Punch/die members required cutting contours નક્કી કરે છે,જેથી ઇચ્છિત features ઉતરે.
  3. Guide pillars/bushes stroke દરમિયાન assembliesનું registration જાળવે છે.
  4. Stripper/pads stockને toolsથી અલગ કરે છે અને જ્યાં જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં holding આપે છે.
  5. Nested punch/die members એક જ station પર blanking/piercing કરે છે;product અને slug માટે યોગ્ય ejection જરૂરી છે.
  6. Scrap/product exit અને feed guidanceથી accumulation તથા positional error ઘટાડાય છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Stockને common stationમાં locate કરવામાં આવે છે;બે અલગ stationsમાં sequential transfer નથી.
  2. Guides nested tool membersનું alignment જાળવે છે.
  3. એક strokeમાં multiple cutting contours કાર્યમાં આવે છે.
  4. તે જ stationમાં તે જ stroke દરમિયાન blanking અને piercing બન્ને થાય છે.
  5. Stripping/ejection દ્વારા product અને scrap અલગ બહાર કાઢવામાં આવે છે.
  6. Complete outer cut profileનો simultaneously produced hole સામેનો સંબંધ તપાસાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Operation, stock position, clearance, alignment, load, stripping; progressiveમાં correct pitch.

Applications / લાભ

Washer, good hole-outline relationshipવાળા flat parts.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Tool complexity, load, ejection demands વધુ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Different operations occur at successive stations as strip advances by a fixed pitch.

Classification / representative type

  • Station sequence: pierce, form/other operations, then cutoff/blanking as designed; not every layout uses the same order.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Upper/lower shoes support aligned tool assemblies.
  2. Punch/die members define the required cutting contours.
  3. Guide pillars/bushes maintain registration under stroke.
  4. Stripper/pads separate stock from tools and manage holding where needed.
  5. Pilots/feed stops and strip carrier maintain station registration; stock must remain connected until intended separation.
  6. Scrap/product exit and feed guidance prevent accumulation and positional error.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Strip enters the first station using approved guarded feed.
  2. An initial feature is made while downstream stations may act on earlier strip positions.
  3. Return permits fixed-pitch advance.
  4. Pilots/registration align previously produced features where designed.
  5. Further stations add features and final station separates completed parts.
  6. After strip fill, the tool can deliver a completed part each appropriate stroke, though a single part took several strokes to traverse.

Working parameters / controls

  • Controls: operation identity, stock positioning, clearance, alignment, load and stripping; progressive tools additionally require correct pitch.

Applications / advantages

High-volume strip production with fewer manual transfers.

Limitations / safety

High initial cost, pitch errors and strip/carrier design strongly affect quality and material utilisation.

Does one completed part per progressive stroke mean one part underwent only one stroke?

No. After strip fill, parts emerge each stroke, but each part travelled through several stations/strokes.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fixed pitchથી strip આગળ વધતાં successive stations પર જુદી operations.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Station sequence designed pierce, form/other, cutoff/blanking; order universal નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Upper/lower shoes aligned tool assembliesને આધાર આપે છે અને loadsને press structure સુધી પહોંચાડે છે.
  2. Punch/die members required cutting contours નક્કી કરે છે,જેથી દરેક stationનું feature ઉતરે.
  3. Guide pillars/bushes stroke દરમિયાન assembliesનું registration જાળવે છે.
  4. Stripper/pads stockને toolsથી અલગ કરે છે અને જ્યાં જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં holding આપે છે.
  5. Pilots/feed stops તથા strip carrier station registration રાખે છે;intended separation સુધી stock જોડાયેલો રહે તે જરૂરી છે.
  6. Scrap/product exit અને feed guidanceથી accumulation તથા positional error ઘટાડાય છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Approved guarded feedથી strip પ્રથમ stationમાં પ્રવેશે છે.
  2. પ્રથમ feature બને છે;તે જ સમયે downstream stations stripના અગાઉ પહોંચેલા ભાગો પર કામ કરી શકે છે.
  3. Return stroke પછી fixed pitch જેટલો strip advance થાય છે,જેથી features આગળના station સુધી જાય.
  4. જ્યાં designમાં હોય ત્યાં pilots/registration અગાઉ બનેલા featuresને ફરી align કરે છે.
  5. આગળનાં stations વધારાના features ઉમેરે છે અને final station completed partને અલગ કરે છે.
  6. Strip fill થયા પછી દરેક suitable strokeમાં completed part મળી શકે છે;પણ એક partને બધા stations પસાર કરવા અનેક strokes લાગ્યા હતા.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Operation, stock position, clearance, alignment, load, stripping; progressiveમાં correct pitch.

Applications / લાભ

High-volume strip production, manual transfers ઓછાં.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

High cost, pitch errors, strip/carrier design quality, utilisation બદલે.

Progressiveમાં Strokeદીઠ Part મળે એટલે Partએ ફક્ત એક Stroke લીધો?

ના.Strip fill પછી strokeદીઠ part મળે,પણ દરેક part અનેક stations/strokesમાંથી પસાર થયો હતો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Plan and document a jig, fixture or press-tool layout for an assigned simple component. No manufactured model or tested layout is claimed here.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Inputs: component drawing, material, dimensions, tolerances, quantity and operation; mark missing information rather than inventing it.
  • Select tooling type by process and batch need; state why a jig, fixture or press tool fits the task.
  • Datum plan: show constrained freedoms,3-2-1contacts or suitable alternative, and clamps acting into supported regions.
  • Draw plan/elevation/section as needed; label body, locators, clamps, bushes or punch/die, tool access, chip/scrap space and loading path.
  • State materials/replaceable wear parts and assumptions; for a press concept separate feature sizing, clearance and preliminary load estimate.
  • Review interference, distortion, repeatability, release, guarding and safe access with supervisor; paper design is not operating approval.
  • Report: problem, selected principle, datum explanation, drawings, part list, calculation basis, review corrections and limitations.
  • Evidence fields: left for actual drawing/revision, reviewer, date and approved photograph/model evidence only.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

આપેલા simple component માટે tooling layout plan/document કરો.અહીં model બનાવ્યો કે layout test કર્યો એવો દાવો નથી.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Inputs drawing, material, dimensions, tolerances, quantity, operation લો;ન મળેલી માહિતી missing લખો, invent નહિ.
  • Process, batch પરથી type પસંદ કરો;આ task માટે jig/fixture/press tool કેમ યોગ્ય તે લખો.
  • Datum planમાં restrained freedoms,3-2-1contacts/alternative અને supports તરફ લાગતા clamps બતાવો.
  • જરૂરી viewsમાં body, locators, clamps, bushes/punch-die, access, chips/scrap, loading path label કરો.
  • Materials, replaceable wear parts, assumptions લખો; pressમાં size, clearance, preliminary load અલગ રાખો.
  • Interference, distortion, repeatability, release, guarding, access supervisor સાથે review; paper design operating approval નહિ.
  • Reportમાં problem, principle, datum, drawings, part list, calculation basis, corrections, limitations.
  • Actual drawing/revision, reviewer, date તથા approved photo/model evidence માટે fields રાખો;ખોટી entries નહિ.

Definition / principle

Source group reports આશરે5pages સૂચવે છે;ફક્ત genuine work/source evidence જોડો.

title.en: Production tooling:classify by function and construction
Clamps:force into supported work,not a new datum
Plate jig:guide plate and work datum
Box jig:enclosure and multiple face support
Leaf jig:hinged guide plate with positive seating
Channel jig:channel body and open loading
Assembly fixture:relative location and fitting access
Blanking versus piercing:product identity determines size control
Simple die:one cutting operation at one station
Compound cutting die:outer blank and inner hole together
Progressive die:multiple stations along one fed strip
